short_en: The process required by the FDA before drugs may be marketed in the U.S. generally involves the following: • FDA approval of an NDA, which must occur before a drug can be marketed or sold.
full_en: The process required by the FDA before drugs may be marketed in the U.S. generally involves the following: • FDA approval of an NDA, which must occur before a drug can be marketed or sold.
